caveats: This is the Lisa Gutierrez lawsuit against former officer Sean Pena, filed June 18, 2021 in Maricopa County Superior Court (removed to U.S. District Court of Arizona). KRDO reports the Phoenix City Council approved a $425,000 settlement in a Pena sexual-assault case on Nov 17, 2021 without naming the plaintiff; because the Krystofer Lee $425,000 settlement was approved separately in June 2021, the Nov 2021 settlement is inferred to be this second suit. AZFamily (Aug 2022) confirms both Lee and Gutierrez settled but does not disclose amounts, so the 425000 figure carries some inference. Pena acquitted across two criminal trials (May 2022 partial acquittal/hung jury; Aug 2022 not guilty on all remaining counts).
